english.note: Use this for an absolute understood specifically as a universally valid or unquestionable truth, such as a moral absolute.

examples.english: Philosophers have debated for thousands of years whether there is an absolute truth in the world.
examples.traditional: 世界上有冇絕對真理，哲學家爭論咗幾千年。
